{'text': 'Apple 已為 iPhone 推出第三個 iOS 27.2 開發者測試版。呢次更新係喺 iOS 27 正式向所有用戶推出之後發佈，亦跳過咗 iOS 27.1，後者係 Apple 主打 iPhone Duo 嘅一個版本。', 'ctx': 'Sentence 0 about Apple launching iOS 27.2 beta 3.'}

{'text': 'iOS 27.2 beta includes revamped Health app and more', 'ctx': 'Sentence 1 about iOS 27.2 beta features.'}

{'text': 'iOS 27.2 will be the version that follows iOS 27, which launched on September 14. iOS 27.1 is dedicated to iPhone Duo.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 2 about iOS 27.2 being the next version after iOS 27.'}

{'text': 'Apple has previously detailed the iOS 27.1 SDK, which lets developers take full advantage of the iPhone Duo display. You can see how apps will appear on iPhone Duo here, depending on which iOS version they target.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 3 about Apple detailing the iOS 27.1 SDK.'}

{'text': 'Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta on September 18, adding an iPhone Duo simulator and app development support for the new foldable iPhone.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 4 about Apple releasing Xcode 27.1 beta.'}

{'text': 'Apple also released the first iOS 27.2 public beta last month.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 5 about Apple releasing the first iOS 27.2 public beta.'}

{'text': 'iOS 27.2 beta includes the following changes:', 'ctx': 'Sentence 6 about iOS 27.2 beta changes.'}

  • {'text': 'The redesigned Apple Health app, first shown off at the iPhone 18 Pro event, is enabled in this beta.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 7 about the redesigned Health app.'}
  • {'text': 'Group FaceTime gets dual camera simultaneous shooting mode.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 8 about Group FaceTime dual camera.'}
  • {'text': 'Siri AI language support adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 9 about Siri AI language support.'}
  • {'text': 'Apple TV app profile feature arrives on iPhone.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 10 about Apple TV app profiles on iPhone.'}
  • {'text': "In Apple Podcasts, 'Up next' is renamed to 'Latest episodes', and 'Continue playing' has been moved just below 'Latest episodes'. Podcast episode lists also gain backgrounds that match the topic color.", 'ctx': 'Sentence 11 about Apple Podcasts changes.'}
  • {'text': 'Apple Music now uses fewer icon colors within the app to label category tags.', 'ctx': 'Sentence 12 about Apple Music icon colors.'}

{'text': "If we spot anything new or any other changes in beta 3, we'll detail them in a separate roundup. Stay tuned to our ongoing iOS 27.2 beta coverage.", 'ctx': 'Sentence 13 about finding new changes in beta 3.'}

{'text': 'Get the most out of your Apple products', 'ctx': 'Sentence 14 about getting the most out of Apple products.'}
